item.name: Searing Signet

effects.title: Burn Through
effects.text: Instances of magic damage from spells over 60 ignites enemies, causing them to take 80 magic damage over 6 seconds. Burn damage against non-hero targets is decreased by 50%.

notes: Will not ignite enemies that are more than 2000 range away.
item.lore: To torture a magic user, one must devise means far beyond the mundane.
